pages.title: Cloning
pages.text: So, you've decided to play God.$(br)<thing>Cloning/$ allows cheaply mass-producing almost any mob (other than bosses), and creating custom variants with special traits.$(br2)Potential applications for cloning include: Mass-production of mob drops, creating hordes
of super-strong pets, creating the ultimate mount, and more.$(br2)

Clones have two stats: Quality and Complexity. Complexity is how complex a mob you're trying to create, Quality is how good a job you've done creating it. As long as Quality is higher than Complexity, no problems. For simple clones, you can skip some processing steps completely. If Complexity gets higher than Quality, clones start having health issues
and may even be completely non-viable. Clones can have special <thing>$(l:essentials:witchcraft/traits)Traits/$ added to them to make them more useful.
